description: InfraNamedWindowViews insert-shape slice: duplicate insert delivery into one keep-all window, intersecting length/unique retention with old-stream replacement, the object-array stream-star insert whose undeclared column is an approved typed-builder difference, and preemptive on-trigger cascade across two named windows (Java source regression-lib/src/main/java/com/espertech/esper/regressionlib/suite/infra/namedwindow/InfraNamedWindowViews.java).

cases.description: keepall named window receives two independent inserts from each SupportBean and its create/s0 listeners flatten the two rows in insert order
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyWindowDISM select theString as key, longBoxed+1 as value from SupportBean
cases.s0Epl: @name('s0') select key, value as value from MyWindowDISM
cases.s2Epl: insert into MyWindowDISM select theString as key, longBoxed+2 as value from SupportBean

cases.description: length(2) and unique(intPrimitive) intersect so E3/intPrimitive=2 emits E3 and expires E1/E2 as old rows
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyWindowINT select * from SupportBean

cases.description: object-array keepall deployment accepts the stream-star c0 source in Java but the typed Go builder rejects undeclared c0 while p0-only remains expressible
cases.insertEpl: insert into MyNWWindowObjectArray select intPrimitive as p0, sb.* as c0 from SupportBean as sb

cases.description: TypeTrigger fires both on-trigger inserts preemptively so OtherStream's s0 observes WinTwo col2=9
cases.createEpl:
create window WinOne#keepall as TypeOne;
create window WinTwo#keepall as TypeTwo
cases.insertEpl: @name('insert-window-one') insert into WinOne(col1) select intPrimitive from SupportBean
cases.s0Epl: @name('s0') on OtherStream select col2 from WinTwo
cases.s2Epl: @name('insert-otherstream') on TypeTrigger insert into OtherStream select col1 from WinOne
cases.s3Epl: @name('insert-window-two') on TypeTrigger insert into WinTwo(col2) select col1 from WinOne

steps.epl: insert into MyWindowDISM select theString as key, longBoxed+1 as value from SupportBean
insert into MyWindowDISM select theString as key, longBoxed+2 as value from SupportBean
@name('s0') select key, value as value from MyWindowDISM
insert into MyWindowINT select * from SupportBean
insert into MyNWWindowObjectArray select intPrimitive as p0, sb.* as c0 from SupportBean as sb

create window WinOne#keepall as TypeOne;
create window WinTwo#keepall as TypeTwo
@name('insert-window-one') insert into WinOne(col1) select intPrimitive from SupportBean
@name('insert-otherstream') on TypeTrigger insert into OtherStream select col1 from WinOne
@name('insert-window-two') on TypeTrigger insert into WinTwo(col2) select col1 from WinOne
@name('s0') on OtherStream select col2 from WinTwo
